info.title: AstrBot OpenAPI v1
info.description: Target REST contract for migrating AstrBot HTTP APIs to /api/v1. Dynamic AstrBot configuration payloads are intentionally modeled as open JSON objects because their schemas are provided at runtime by template endpoints. Developer API keys currently support these scopes only: bot, provider, persona, im, config, chat, kb, memory, data, file, plugin, mcp, and skill. The config scope also grants bot and provider access.
